content.text: K < 2.5 mEq/L: use IV K, ⍉PO. Monitor K and adjust; recheck periodically during maintenance. Take w meals and a glass of H2O, ⍉ on an empty stomach (gastric irritate); swallow whole (⍉ crush, chew or suck). Doses > 40 mEq/day: divide so ≤ 40 mEq per dose. Hypokalemia: typically 40 to 100 mEq/day; maintenance or prophylaxis: typically 20 mEq/day. CI: triamterene or amiloride (severe hyperkalemia). Solid forms can cause ulcerative or stenotic GI lesions; consider liquid K in dysphagia or severe GI motility dx. Severe vomiting, abd pain, distention or GI bleed: stop and consider ulceration, obstruct or perf. RAAS inhibitors (ACEi, ARB, spironolactone, eplerenone, aliskiren): closely monitor K; NSAIDs: closely monitor K.
